A '''planet''' was controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] facilities on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] were [[Battle of unidentified planet (shielded city)|under siege]] by Republic forces for days when they were sabotaged by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] prior to the battle. After the facilities were sabotaged by the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], many [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]], [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]], and [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 fighters]] stormed the defenseless [[City/Legends|city]], with victory for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] assured.

==Behind the scenes==
The planet is one of many unnamed planets in the television episode "[[Chapter 22 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|Clone Wars Chapter 22]]."
